title: Closure operations for the right-adjoint tensor-comparison isomorphism locus
statement: Let $f:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the derived categories, pullback, pushforward, and tensor of [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Suppose these quasi-coherent derived categories have coproducts, pushforward restricts to them, the unit on Y is quasi-coherent, and $Lf^*K\otimes E$ is quasi-coherent for all quasi-coherent K,E. Fix any monoidal structure on Lf*, an adjunction $Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$, and a right adjoint c to the quasi-coherent restriction of Rf*, with specified adjunction. Suppose c preserves all coproducts indexed by sets in the scheme universe. Let P consist of K for which there is an isomorphism pf from $Rf_*(Lf^*K\otimes c(\mathcal O_Y))$ to $K\otimes Rf_*c(\mathcal O_Y)$ whose inverse is the pullback-adjunction mate of the inverse monoidal tensor comparison followed by the pullback counit, and for which the right-adjunction mate of pf followed by $K\otimes\epsilon_{\mathcal O_Y}$ and the right unitor is invertible. Then P is closed under isomorphisms of quasi-coherent objects, ambient shifts, third objects of ambient distinguished triangles with first two objects in P, ambient retracts, and ambient coproduct cofans of objects in P transported by an isomorphism to a quasi-coherent object. This asserts only closure operations; it does not assert perfect objects lie in P or that every object lies in P.

proof.text: The qcqs derived projection formula supplies pf for each K; its inverse is uniquely pinned by the pullback adjunction. Naturality of the tensor comparison and both counits makes the displayed mates a natural comparison Lf*(-) tensor c(O_Y) to c(-). K-flat pullback and tensor are exact; the right adjoint of exact pushforward is exact by adjunction. The comparison respects shifts by counit and monoidal coherence.

Naturality transports invertibility across object isomorphisms; shift compatibility transports it across shifts. The comparison gives a morphism between distinguished triangles; two invertible components force the third to be invertible. A retract diagram gives a retract of comparison arrows, and the explicit retraction transports an inverse, giving retract closure.

Pullback, as a left adjoint, and K-flat tensor preserve coproducts, while c preserves them by hypothesis. The comparison on a coproduct is conjugate to the coproduct of its components and is therefore invertible when all components are. Quasi-coherent cohomology is closed under ambient termwise coproducts; the inclusion of the full subcategory creates these coproducts. This identifies every ambient cofan in the statement with the quasi-coherent coproduct and transports the result to the given object.

theorem rightAdjointTensorLocus_localizing
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)]
    [HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z)]
    (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj))
    (hO : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y)))
    (hTensor : ∀ (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z),
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ E.obj))
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z)
    (adj : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hRf ⊣ c)
    (hsums : ∀ I : Type u, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) c) :
    let P : ObjectProperty (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) := fun K ↦
      ∃ pf : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
            (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ≅
          K.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
          pf.inv = (a.homEquiv _ _)
            ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (derivedPullback f) K.obj
              ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)).inv ≫
              (derivedPullback f).obj K.obj ◁ a.counit.app (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ∧
          IsIso ((adj.homEquiv
            ⟨((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
              hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩)⟩ K)
            (ObjectProperty.homMk (pf.hom ≫
              K.obj ◁ (adj.counit.app ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).hom ≫ (ρ_ K.obj).hom)))
    (∀ (A B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), P A → Nonempty (A ≅ B) → P B) ∧
    (∀ (A : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (n : ℤ), P A →
      ∀ (B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), Nonempty (B.obj ≅ A.obj⟦n⟧) → P B) ∧
    (∀ (A B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), P A → P B →
      ∀ (T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (schemeDerivedCategory Y)),
        T ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles →
        Nonempty (T.obj₁ ≅ A.obj) → Nonempty (T.obj₂ ≅ B.obj) →
        ∀ (C : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), Nonempty (T.obj₃ ≅ C.obj) → P C) ∧
    (∀ (A B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), P B →
      Nonempty (Retract A.obj B.obj) → P A) ∧
    (∀ (J : Type u) (E : J → schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y),
      ∀ (S : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (ι : ∀ j, (E j).obj ⟶ S),
        IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι) →
        ∀ (B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), Nonempty (B.obj ≅ S) →
          (∀ j, P (E j)) → P B)
